title: Will this require a premium account?
body:
Excited to see you making this. There isn't much out for Command Palette extensions yet but I'm optimistic. I was curious if this will require a Spotify Premium subscription? I know there was a plugin for PowerToys Run that required one. Unfortunately I dropped premium a while ago. 

Thanks for all of your hard work.
author: Byrnesdigital

comments.body:
Endpoints that control playback, such as play or pause, require a Premium subscription.
There's no way around it :(
